note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, only the soldier and worker being described; synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow to pale orange yellow, antennae, body and legs paler, mandibles dark brown. Head moderately pilose, body rather densely pilose, setae on the frontal projection and fontanelle region more numerous than on the rest of the head. Body length 5.2 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, lateral margins undulate, widest at the anterior third; frontal projection broad, slightly projecting and notched (length to mandible base 1.20–1.30 mm, length to apex of frontal projection 1.17–1.29 mm, maximum width 1.00 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 clavate, longer than segment 2; segment 4 about as long as segment 2. Labrum subrectangular, anterior margin deeply and broadly incurved, anterolateral margins projecting forward as angles, outer margin finely serrate (length 0.30–0.33 mm, width 0.27–0.28 mm). Mandibles slender and rod-like, much longer than head (length 1.43–1.47 mm, left mandible length/head length 1.14–1.23). Postmentum short, rod-like, widest slightly above the middle, waist near the posterior end (length 0.47 mm, maximum width 0.31–0.33 mm, waist width 0.23–0.27 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly concave (length 0.20 mm, width 0.47–0.50 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow, antennae, thorax and legs nearly white, abdomen semi-transparent; head and body rather densely pilose. Body length 3.9–4.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to apex of labrum 1.10–1.17 mm, length to mandible base 0.70–0.80 mm, maximum width 0.87–0.90 mm). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus strongly inflated, pilose, half as long as wide (length 0.23–0.25 mm, width 0.47–0.50 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, both anterior and posterior margins notched (length 0.20–0.23 mm, width 0.47–0.50 mm).
